parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_documents WHERE source_type = 'outline')::int AS outline_documents,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_chunks c JOIN knowledge_documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.source_type = 'outline')::int AS outline_chunks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_documents WHERE source_type = 'repo')::int AS repo_documents,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_chunks c JOIN knowledge_documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.source_type = 'repo')::int AS repo_chunks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_documents)::int AS total_documents,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_chunks)::int AS total_chunks,
  (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM knowledge_documents WHERE source_type = 'outline') AS last_outline_update,
  (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM knowledge_documents WHERE source_type = 'repo') AS last_repo_update,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE embedding_model IS NOT NULL)::int AS embedded_chunks
